newsitem.title: USA: Magellan Petroleum up on stock-picker nod.
newsitem.headline: Magellan Petroleum up on stock-picker nod.

text.p: Magellan Petroleum Corp jumped nearly 50 percent in late morning activity on Thursday after an investment professional made the company his pick in a stock selection contest run by the Wall Street Journal.

The investment professional, F.X.C. Investors Corp president Francis Curzio, has scored four consecutive victories in the Journal's contest. His most recent victory came with Canada Southern Petroleum Ltd, which surged 60.2 percent between February 10 and July 31.
"Here's a guy, Curzio, who's won the contest four times running," said one trader. "That's enough for me."
Magellan shares rose 1-3/16 or 48.7 percent to 3-5/8, the top percentage gainer on Nasdaq.
